name: DCA Lamplight Lounge Crispy Yukon Gold Potato Skins (Sauce on Side Mod)
brandOrRestaurant: Lamplight Lounge (Pixar Pier · Disney California Adventure)
whyItWorks: Unlike hollowed-out fibrous potato peels, Lamplight's "Potato Skins" are actually pillowy-soft mashed Yukon Gold potato cakes with a crisp exterior.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Ask your server to serve the smoked paprika aioli and brown-butter caper yogurt **on the side** so you can eat the warm Yukon Gold potato cakes plain.
watchOuts: Default plating includes smoked paprika aioli and yogurt sauce—request sauces on the side
